caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher rendered in shades of gray, suggesting pencil or ink as the medium. The pitcher has an elongated body with vertical slightly convex segments, a beaded rim, a gracefully curved handle on the left, and a long, slightly curved spout on the right. The base is a thick, raised, and stepped circular pedestal, adorned with bead-like decoration near the top edge. On the upper body of the pitcher, there is an intricate monogram or decorative motif made of swirling lines. The pitcher sits alone with no other objects present, centered on an otherwise plain, off-white background. The artist's name, "David R. Whiting," is inscribed in small print to the lower right of the pitcher.
title: Monogrammed Silver Cream Pitcher
